editorial:
Imagine finding a dead body in the White House bathroom right in the middle of a global crisis. That is exactly how things kick off for Detective Harlan Regis. He is a no-nonsense cop who has to deal with the Secret Service just to do his job. You will love the chemistry between Regis and Agent Nina Chance, who starts off as a roadblock but eventually becomes his main ally. The vibe is a total throwback to those 90s political thrillers where everyone has a secret and nobody is who they seem to be. It feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse played inside the most famous house in the world.

What really works here is the pacing; it keeps you guessing and moves quickly from one clue to the next. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the action sequences and the tension make up for it. If you enjoy stories about underdogs fighting a corrupt system, you should definitely give this one a shot. It looks great if you can find it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp picture, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to dive in. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a solid move for a rainy weekend movie night.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the murder was part of a plot to hide a political scandal involving the Vice President. After being framed as traitors, Regis and Nina sneak back into the White House to find the real evidence. They manage to expose the truth and catch the bad guys just in time. The movie ends with the conspiracy being blown wide open and the heroes getting their reputations back while the villains go to jail.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school crime thrillers and government conspiracies.
